nodes.name: power_3v3
nodes.description: ME6211 LDO regulator provides 3.3V system rail from VIN_5V. CE pin tied high for enable (requires external pull-up logic). Input and output require bypass capacitors. This module is the sole provider of VCC_3V3 to downstream modules.

nodes.name: CE
nodes.description: Chip Enable. ME6211C: active high (>=1.0V ON). Tie to VIN for always-on.

nodes.name: mcu
nodes.description: ATmega328P MCU core. VCC and AVCC powered from VCC_3V3; AREF can be connected to VCC_3V3 or left unconnected. Uses PB4/PB5 for SPI to flash (MOSI/MISO). Uses PC4/PC5 for I2C to IMU (SDA/SCL). No crystal pins provided in component list, so assumes internal oscillator. BOOT configuration pins not present, assumes normal Flash execution. This module owns pull-up resistors for the shared I2C bus.

nodes.name: PC6
nodes.description: Port C bit 6 / RESET input (active low), I/O if RSTDISBL fuse programmed

nodes.name: PD0
nodes.description: Port D bit 0, digital I/O with internal pull-up

nodes.name: PD1
nodes.description: Port D bit 1, digital I/O with internal pull-up

nodes.name: PD2
nodes.description: Port D bit 2, digital I/O with internal pull-up, INT0 interrupt

nodes.name: PD3
nodes.description: Port D bit 3, digital I/O with internal pull-up, INT1 interrupt

nodes.name: PD4
nodes.description: Port D bit 4, digital I/O with internal pull-up

nodes.name: PB6
nodes.description: Port B bit 6 / XTAL1 input, oscillator amplifier input or TOSC1

nodes.name: PB7
nodes.description: Port B bit 7 / XTAL2 output, oscillator amplifier output or TOSC2

nodes.name: PD5
nodes.description: Port D bit 5, digital I/O with internal pull-up

nodes.name: PD6
nodes.description: Port D bit 6, digital I/O with internal pull-up

nodes.name: PB3
nodes.description: Port B bit 3, digital I/O with internal pull-up, MOSI/SPI

nodes.name: PB4
nodes.description: Port B bit 4, digital I/O with internal pull-up, MISO/SPI

nodes.name: PB5

nodes.name: AVCC
nodes.description: Analog supply voltage for ADC and PC3:0, should connect to VCC via low-pass filter

nodes.name: AREF
nodes.description: Analog reference pin for A/D Converter

nodes.name: PC0
nodes.description: Port C bit 0 / ADC0, analog input or digital I/O

nodes.name: PC1
nodes.description: Port C bit 1 / ADC1, analog input or digital I/O

nodes.name: PC2
nodes.description: Port C bit 2 / ADC2, analog input or digital I/O

nodes.name: PC3
nodes.description: Port C bit 3 / ADC3, analog input or digital I/O

nodes.name: PC4
nodes.description: Port C bit 4 / ADC4 / SDA, analog input, digital I/O, or I2C data

nodes.name: PC5
nodes.description: Port C bit 5 / ADC5 / SCL, analog input, digital I/O, or I2C clock

nodes.name: imu
nodes.description: MPU-6050 6-axis IMU. Operates as I2C slave. AD0 pin sets I2C address (requires external tie to GND or VCC). INT pin provides interrupt output to MCU. CS pin must be tied high to enable I2C mode. No pull-ups placed here (owned by MCU module). FSYNC pin unused.

nodes.name: CLKIN
nodes.description: Optional external reference clock input. Connect to GND if unused.

nodes.name: AUX_DA
nodes.description: I2C master serial data for connecting external sensors (e.g. magnetometer).

nodes.name: AUX_CL
nodes.description: I2C master serial clock output for connecting external sensors.

nodes.name: CS
nodes.description: SPI chip select, active low. Tie to VDD for I2C mode.

nodes.name: AD0
nodes.description: I2C address LSB. GND=0x68, VDD=0x69. SPI mode: SDO output.

nodes.name: REGOUT
nodes.description: Internal regulator output. Connect 0.1uF capacitor to GND.

nodes.name: FSYNC
nodes.description: Frame synchronization input. Connect to GND if unused.

nodes.name: INT
nodes.description: Interrupt output, configurable as push-pull or open-drain.

nodes.name: CPOUT
nodes.description: Charge pump capacitor connection. Connect 2.2nF capacitor to GND.

nodes.name: flash
nodes.description: W25Q64JV SPI NOR Flash memory. Operates as SPI slave. CS, CLK, DI (MOSI), DO (MISO) connect directly. WP and HOLD pins require logic level control (can be tied high or driven by MCU GPIO). No pull-ups placed here.

nodes.name: CS
nodes.description: Chip Select, active low. Pull-up recommended for controlled power-up.

nodes.name: WP
nodes.description: Write Protect, active low (IO2 in Quad mode). Tie to VCC for normal operation.

nodes.name: HOLD
nodes.description: Hold/Reset, active low (IO3 in Quad mode). Tie to VCC for normal operation.
